claims.claim_text: Redwire is the prime mission integrator on DARPA's Otter program leveraging the SabreSat platform for a revolutionary air-breathing VLEO satellite.
claims.subject: Redwire Corporation
claims.source_quote: Redwire is the prime mission integrator on the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency's (DARPA) Otter program in the U.S., which is leveraging the SabreSat platform to develop a revolutionary air-breathing satellite system

claims.claim_text: Edge Autonomy acquisition completed June 13, 2025 for $1.024B (cash $160M + 49.76M shares at $19.08 + adjustments); produced $107.1M of FY25 revenue and $721M of goodwill. Rollup thesis: bolt UAS / defense-tech onto a space-infrastructure rollup of Hera/Made-In-Space/Adcole/Roccor.
claims.subject: Redwire Corporation
claims.object_value: Edge Autonomy + Hera + MIS + Adcole + Roccor
claims.source_quote: Edge Autonomy acquisition ... Purchase consideration $ 1,024,732 ... Goodwill $ 721,324 ... $107.1 million of revenue related to the Edge Autonomy acquisition

kwargs.parent_thesis: Redwire is a space-infrastructure rollup integrating heritage in-space hardware (Made In Space additive manufacturing, Adcole sun-sensors, Roccor deployables, Hera Systems imaging) into a single space-segment platform.
acquisitions: Edge Autonomy (small UAS / drones - Stalker, Penguin)

claims.claim_text: Redwire's adverse ICFR opinion: management concluded internal control over financial reporting was NOT effective as of Dec 31, 2025; KPMG issued an adverse opinion citing pervasive process-level control deficiencies and lack of ITGCs in European/remaining U.S. operations. Prior Lemen securities class action alleged material weaknesses in financial reporting; settled for $8.0M in 2025.
claims.subject: Redwire Corporation
claims.source_quote: management concluded that our internal control over financial reporting was not effective as of December 31, 2025 because of the material weaknesses ... KPMG LLP ... issued an adverse opinion on the effectiveness of our int[ernal control]

claims.claim_text: Redwire raised meaningful equity in 2025 via ATM facility and equity offerings; convertible preferred PIK dividends totaled $47.1M and 21.5M common shares were issued upon preferred conversion; Edge merger added another 49.76M shares (heavy dilution event clustered to fund-raise / deal closes).
claims.subject: Redwire Corporation
claims.object_value: ATM + Bain repurchase + 49.76M Edge shares + 21.5M preferred conversions in 2025
claims.source_quote: net proceeds received from the issuance of common stock through the ATM facility, equity offerings ... issuance of 49,764,847 shares of the Company's common stock (Equity Consideration) ... 61,895.39 shares of the Company's Convertible Preferred Stock were ... converted into 21,529,115 shares of the Company's common stock

claims.claim_text: Redwire operates from 28 locations (23 NA + 5 EU) totaling ~910,000 sq ft, including 5 facilities in California, 4 in Colorado, multiple in Florida (HQ Jacksonville), with manufacturing/flight test infrastructure spanning US and EU (Latvia, Luxembourg, Poland, Ukraine, Belgium).
claims.subject: Redwire Corporation
claims.source_quote: We operate from 23 locations in North America and 5 locations in Europe consisting of offices, warehouses, service centers, laboratories and other facilities approximating 910,000 sq ft

claims.claim_text: Redwire claims patented Roll-Out Solar Array (ROSA) technology and broader space-infrastructure IP from acquired entities (Made In Space, Adcole, Roccor) plus combat-proven UAS (Stalker, Penguin, Octopus) IP via Edge Autonomy.
claims.subject: Redwire Corporation
claims.source_quote: Redwire's patented and award-winning Roll-Out Solar Array (ROSA) technology ... Redwire is the OEM for the Octopus line of ISR and optical gimbal camera payloads

claims.claim_text: Redwire claims contracted backlog of $411.2M at Dec 31, 2025 ($299.8M Space + $111.4M Defense Tech) and performs directly or via primes (Lockheed, Northrop, etc.) for U.S. Army, Marines, Air Force, Space Force, DARPA, NRO, NASA, ESA.
claims.subject: Redwire Corporation
claims.source_quote: As of December 31, 2025, our total contracted backlog was $411.2 million of which $299.8 million related to the Space segment and $111.4 million related to the Defense Tech segment.
